propositions: Existing stores lack `.bridge_state/projects.json` and `bridge_project` fields on tickets, causing upgrade to read all tickets as absent-project with no recorded legacy default, breaking sync convergence.

Two idempotent ensure units (seed-mapping and convergence-stamp) must migrate the store without writing ticket events, each check-then-act and safe to re-run, committing zero times when already converged.

The seed unit writes `.bridge_state/projects.json` with `legacy_default` from `Backend.project` and single `projects` entry if absent; the stamp unit adds `multi-project-bridge` to `required_capabilities` only when mapping holds multiple projects and capability is missing.
The migration must integrate into the idempotent registry in `src/rebar/_store/ensures.py` with new ensure-unit ids, never reused, and update test fixtures and documentation accordingly.
Two new ensure units live in new file `src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py` (cohesion, not size), with registry entries and test-freeze literal updated in `ensures.py` and `test_ensures.py`.
The sweep must write zero ticket events, converge on second run with identical branch tip SHA, and handle failures gracefully without aborting the sweep.
